scripts.build: NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 next build --turbopack && ([ "$NODE_ENV" = "production" ] && prisma migrate deploy --schema ./prisma-main/schema.prisma || true)
scripts.prisma:generate: npx prisma generate --no-hints --schema ./prisma-main/schema.prisma && npx prisma generate --no-hints --schema ./prisma-e2e/schema.prisma
scripts.test:e2e: node e2e/setup-e2e-db.js && CI=true E2E_TEST=true NEXT_PUBLIC_BETTER_AUTH_URL= npm run build && concurrently -k -s first "CI=true E2E_TEST=true NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 next start --port 39147" "playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts"
scripts.test:e2e:coverage: node e2e/setup-e2e-db.js && concurrently -k -s first "CI=true E2E_TEST=true COVERAGE=true NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npm run dev:coverage -- --port 39147" "COVERAGE=true playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts"
scripts.test:e2e:docker:rebuild: npm run test:e2e:docker:setup && npm run test:e2e:docker:build
scripts.test:e2e:docker: node e2e/setup-e2e-db.js && CI=true E2E_TEST=true NEXT_PUBLIC_BETTER_AUTH_URL= npm run build && concurrently -k -s first "CI=true E2E_TEST=true NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 next start --port 39147" "docker-compose -f e2e/docker-compose.yml up --abort-on-container-exit"
scripts.test:e2e:docker:coverage: node e2e/setup-e2e-db.js && concurrently -k -s first "CI=true E2E_TEST=true COVERAGE=true NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 NEXT_PUBLIC_BETTER_AUTH_URL=http://host.docker.internal:39147 npm run dev:coverage -- --port 39147" "COVERAGE=true docker-compose -f e2e/docker-compose.yml up --abort-on-container-exit"
scripts.coverage:merge: mkdir -p coverage/merged && nyc merge coverage/unit coverage/e2e --report-dir coverage/merged && nyc report --reporter=lcov --reporter=text --report-dir=coverage/merged
